slabbed.settings.pot_seat.flush.tooltip: Flower pots sit right on the surface you can see, with no gap. This only changes pots you place from now on.
Flower pots keep the small gap vanilla leaves above the surface. This only changes pots you place from now on, and on a server it is the server's setting that decides.
